generation: Transfer each frozen search witness by action semantics to each declared legal variation; reject ambiguous physical references or divergent prompts, then use bounded search from the common parent. Never import diagnostic pair routes into teaching.
weighting: Equal pair mass in both arms; six equally weighted scenes per pair in varied arm versus one repeated scene per pair in narrow arm. Both process 24 lesson histories and ten retention histories each update.
split: All scenes retain the exposed elfnote family. Two failed pairs are exposed development transfer probes, never unseen tests. Twelve new conditions are frozen before fitting and used only at baseline and fixed endpoints; they are within-family transfer, not independent families.
admission: Require all 24 planned lessons to be successful, exact-double-replayed and independently core-audited. Otherwise stop before optimization. Same GPU throughout; full serial/batched history error below 0.002.
minimum_gain: Varied minus narrow at least 2 of 12 fresh within-family evaluation conditions, no loss on four base training conditions or original five / old five. Exposed diagnostic pair results separate. No production promotion.
grading: Unchanged original single-card terminal lower bounds, stable resolution boundary, passive opponent. No claim of optimal two-starter boards, functional interruption recovery, fair-play search or full-game strength.
interruptions: Functional recovery goals require a separate frozen protocol after this passive coverage experiment; no retroactive change to these goals or metrics.
